stack: Hugo site on the PaperMod theme (git submodule), overridden via assets/css/extended
hard: the site's own CSS in assets/css/extended/ overrides the theme's vars, so themes/PaperMod values are defaults, not the look; PaperMod's --primary is the text color and the brand color is the site's --accent; dark is the .dark class; a Jekyll-era stylesheet sits unlinked in static/
